title: asmfea neutral model
description: model.json: the only contract between the SolidWorks add-in and the Python pipeline. Units fixed: mm, N, tonne, s, MPa. Positions and directions in the assembly frame unless stated. study.json uses the same schema with every top-level key optional except schema_version, and is merged over model.json at load time.

welds.description: Weld beads (SolidWorks cosmetic weld beads), schema 1.1

hinges.description: Hinges the user added by choosing concentric cylindrical faces (schema 1.x, D50)

joins.description: Connections the user added between two parts with the Join button (D97)

issues.description: Problems the add-in found while extracting; the pipeline reports each as a diagnostic

params.description: Values for the catalogue wording, and evidence

view.description: The SolidWorks view at export (assembly frame): the report's plots use it as their main view

sn_curves.description: S-N curves stored with the SolidWorks material (its Fatigue SN Curves tab: .sldmat materialcurve type 19), read by the add-in; fatigue uses the fully reversed one (r_ratio -1) when study.fatigue gives none for the material (D109)

r_ratio.description: Stress ratio of the test (min / max stress): -1 fully reversed

source.description: Where it came from, e.g. the SolidWorks material library's name

body.description: Descriptors of this body in the PART frame, used to find it among the solids of the STEP file. May be omitted when the part's STEP file holds this one solid only (D53).

parts.description: Parts owning the path edges or the weld-from/to faces

path.description: Weld path as polylines, assembly frame, mm

partial.description: A from-to length weld (not supported yet)

step.description: Path relative to the study folder

transform.description: Row-major 4x4, part frame to assembly frame; translation in elements 3, 7, 11

subassembly.description: Top-level sub-assembly the part sits in (schema 1.1); a sub-assembly is treated as rigid, like one multi-body part

profile.description: Profile type plus its dimensions (b, h, t, r_out, d, tw, tf as applicable), part frame, mm; optional source (the weldment profile file)

path.description: Part frame, mm; clean span positions s are measured from p0 towards p1

type.description: SolidWorks mate type, e.g. coincident, concentric, lock, hinge, slot, width, slider, distance, angle, limit

lock_rotation.description: concentric, profile center: the mate's Lock rotation option (the hinge is then bonded)

profile.description: profile center: round profiles turn about their common axis unless locked

ratio.description: gear: ratio numerator and denominator (in the order of the entities)

distance_per_rev.description: rack and pinion: rack travel per pinion revolution; screw: lead (mm per revolution)

reverse.description: gear, rack and pinion, screw: the mate's Reverse option

limits.description: distance, angle: the mate's limits (minimum, maximum; mm or degrees) when it is a limit mate: the parts may move between them

normal.description: Outward normal at the centroid projection (planes)

point.description: A point on the face, assembly frame (mm): the face is the one the point lies on (D53; for files written without the add-in, e.g. layoutcad). Used when fingerprint is absent

magnitude.description: force, remote_force: N total; pressure: MPa (positive pushes into the face); gravity: mm/s^2; hydrostatic: a load factor on its pressures (1 = as defined)

offset.description: remote_force: application point as an offset (mm, assembly axes) from the area-weighted centroid of its faces; used when point is absent. hydrostatic: the top of the fluid, the same way

density.description: hydrostatic: the fluid's density, kg/m^3 (default water, 1000)

surface_pressure.description: hydrostatic: absolute pressure on the top of the fluid, MPa (default 1 atmosphere, 0.101325); 1 atmosphere is taken to act outside, so the faces get the difference

scale_in_buckling.description: false = applied as preload in buckling steps (self-weight)

dofs.description: displacement: constrained global directions (zero displacement). pinned: translations held at the face centroid (default all three)

hold_rotations.description: pinned: global rotation axes also held (e.g. [3] stops twisting about Z); others are free

faces.description: face_refs ids: one or more concentric cylindrical faces (holes, pin surfaces); the concentric faces of the other parts along the axis are found

lock_rotation.description: the parts may not turn about the axis: the hinge is bonded

faces.description: face_refs ids: none (the nearest faces of the two parts are bonded, within the join gap limit), one (that face to the nearest face of the other part, within the limit) or one on each part (joined whatever the distance: bonded when they meet, else a rigid link)

interface.description: Interface id from connections.json; absent = applies to every interface between the parts

params.description: Type-specific settings, e.g. sliding: {"direction": [x, y, z]} (assembly frame; used before a cylinder axis or mate direction); bolted: size, preload ...

load_superposition.description: Solve each load on its own once; a load case is then the sum of its loads, so changing only load sizes needs no new solve (linear static only; D39)

bond_tolerance.description: Faces this close (a gap or an overlap, mm) count as touching and are bonded; default 0.5

connection_method.description: How connections are found: bond_first bonds everything touching and keeps a mate's joint only where it frees something (D81); auto chooses bond_first on models with many parts

excluded_parts.description: Parts left out of the analysis by the user (the floating-parts dialog); never suppressed in SolidWorks

rigid_parts.description: Parts treated as rigid (D96): not meshed, each group of them moves as one rigid body carrying its weight (density x CAD volume) at its centre of mass; the SolidWorks material is not changed

fatigue.description: Fatigue assessment on the static results (release 2, PLAN-FATIGUE.md, D102): the spectrum, the standard, the S-N data per material

standard.description: The standard whose curves and categories are used and named in the report; default bs7608 (the UK standard)

case.description: Load case at the cycle's maximum

max_pct.description: The maximum, as a percentage of that load case

min_pct.description: The minimum, as a percentage of min_case (negative for a load that reverses)

min_case.description: Load case at the minimum, when the cycle runs between two cases; default case

cycles.description: Cycles of this row in one block of the spectrum

design_blocks.description: Times the spectrum's block is repeated in the design life; default 1

basquin.description: The user's curve, fully reversed amplitude: sigma_a = Sf (2N)^b

endurance_limit.description: Amplitude below which a constant-amplitude spectrum does no damage

points.description: The user's curve as [cycles, fully reversed amplitude MPa] points, log-log interpolated; below the last point's amplitude, no damage

standard_class.description: A parent-material class of the study's standard instead of a user curve (bs7608 B or C, en1993_1_9 160/140/125, en13001_3_1 D.1)

surface_factor.description: Surface finish factor on a user curve's strength; default 1

size_factor.description: Size factor on a user curve's strength; default 1

surface.description: Surface finish for AsmFEA's built-in S-N data (D111): Marin's factor for steel; default hot_rolled for steel, polished otherwise

source.description: Where the S-N data came from (printed in the report)

mean_stress.description: Mean-stress correction on a user curve; default goodman

range.description: Range measure: the largest-magnitude principal of the range tensor (default) or the signed von Mises range

method.description: dong (default): structural stress per window along each bonded joint on the standard's structural stress curve (W1); nominal: the joint's nominal stress on a detail category given per joint (W2)

structural_category.description: W1's curve: a class or category of the standard (default: bs7608 / pd5500 class D, en1993_1_9 Annex B category 90; en13001_3_1 has none and uses EN 1993-1-9's)

category.description: The detail category or class of the study's standard

thread.description: EN 13001-3-1 Table D.2 detail 2.6: rolled threads (default) or machined

gamma_Ff.description: Partial factor on the stress ranges; default 1

gamma_Mf.description: Partial factor on the fatigue strength (EN 1993-1-9 Table 3.1, EN 13001-3-1 Table 9); default 1

favour.description: What the run planner favours (D60): it chooses the mesh level, solver and convergence pass from this and the computer's free memory and cores; default balanced

fidelity.description: Advanced override of the planner's mesh level

solver.description: Advanced override of the planner's solver choice; default auto

convergence_check.description: Advanced override: solve again on a refined mesh and report the change (the planner decides when absent)

refine_unconverged.description: Advanced override: after the two solves, mesh the parts that did not converge finer again and solve a third time (on with Optimise for Accuracy when absent)

max_stress.description: Allowable von Mises stress, MPa: FAIL when any part's peak away from bonded joints exceeds it (D53)
